# Error Handling Checklist: SPEC-009C4 - Owner Merge Gate and Done Reconciliation

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for fail-closed manual GitHub sync, exact PR evidence errors, side-effect-free failed reconciliation, cleanup failure evidence, and bounded operator-facing error records.
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are external GitHub sync transport/API failure requirements complete enough to keep a linked pilot task out of `done`, record a failed sync result, and avoid local-only terminal completion? [Resolved, Spec FR-019, Spec SC-009, Research Failed Sync Decision, Contract Completion Rule]
- [ ] CHK002 Are failed reconciliation requirements complete for missing PR evidence, unmerged linked PR evidence, closed-only issue evidence, mismatched repo/PR evidence, supporting-only merge metadata, fixture-only evidence, and sync failure cases? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, Spec FR-006, Spec FR-007, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK003 Are side-effect boundaries for failed reconciliation complete enough to forbid status writes to `done`, done label projection, stale ready label removal, terminal `github_pr_merged` activity, task-chain advancement, duplicate launch, and cleanup work? [Resolved, Spec FR-019, Data Model Reconciliation Evidence, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK004 Are live UAT cleanup failure requirements complete enough to document the failure, preserve reconciliation state, and distinguish cleanup failure from merge/sync reconciliation failure? [Resolved, Spec FR-020, Spec SC-010, Data Model Fresh Synthetic Pilot PR, Contract Live UAT Cleanup Failure]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Are error reasons for insufficient PR evidence distinguishable enough for operators to tell missing, unmerged, mismatched, closed-only, supporting-only, fixture-only, and sync-failure outcomes apart? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK006 Is authoritative merged PR proof clearly separated from supporting audit fields such as issue-closed state, labels, `merged_at`, or `merge_commit_sha`? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Completion Rule]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the manual sync error response boundary clear about using existing sync status/error evidence rather than adding polling, webhooks, scheduler state, packet state, or a new sync API? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-017, Plan Constraints]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do the spec, plan, data model, contract, and quickstart consistently require failed or insufficient reconciliation to leave the task in `ready_for_owner` until exact merged PR truth is observed? [Consistency, Spec FR-002, Spec FR-007, Data Model PR-Producing Pilot Task, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK009 Do duplicate-sync idempotency requirements stay consistent with failed-reconciliation requirements so repeated failures do not flood activities, notifications, labels, launches, or cleanup work? [Consistency, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-010, Contract Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK010 Do fixture-boundary requirements consistently prevent mocked evidence or test-only payloads from satisfying live smoke proof or production completion? [Consistency, Spec FR-015, Contract Test Fixture Boundary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can failed sync and insufficient evidence cases be objectively measured as no `done` transition, no terminal event, no duplicate launch, and reconciliation-required or failed-sync evidence? [Measurability, Spec SC-003, Spec SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Can successful reconciliation be objectively distinguished from error handling by exact PR identity, explicit merged truth, successful sync evidence, `done` status, terminal activity, and done label projection? [Measurability, Spec SC-002, Spec SC-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Can cleanup failure evidence be objectively reviewed from smoke-checklist text without requiring a new packet schema, binary manifest, lifecycle snapshot API, evidence dashboard, or packet UI? [Measurability, Spec FR-012, Spec FR-013, Spec FR-017]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are primary, exception, recovery, and duplicate error scenarios covered for manual sync failure, closed-only evidence, mismatched PR evidence, missing evidence, and repeated syncs? [Coverage, Spec User Story 3, Spec User Story 4, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are local-only status mutation and supporting-only GitHub metadata covered as insufficient evidence even when the issue is closed or the PR has audit metadata? [Coverage, Spec FR-008, Spec Clarifications Session 2]
- [ ] CHK016 Are live-smoke cleanup and retention edge cases covered without letting cleanup failure hide the reconciled or unreconciled task state? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Quickstart Live UAT Evidence]
